def hamming_parity_bits(k):
    r = 0
    while (1 << r) < k + r + 1:
        r += 1
    return r

print("=== Hamming code: how many parity bits for k data bits ===")
print("condition: 2^r >= k + r + 1")
print(f"{'data bits k':>12} {'parity r':>9} {'2^r':>6} {'k+r+1':>7} {'total':>6} positions")
for k in (1, 2, 4, 8, 11, 16, 32, 64):
    r = hamming_parity_bits(k)
    positions = [1 << i for i in range(r)]
    print(f"{k:>12} {r:>9} {1<<r:>6} {k+r+1:>7} {k+r:>6} {positions}")
print()
print("parity bits sit at positions 1,2,4,8,... (powers of two)")
print("Hamming detects 2-bit errors and CORRECTS 1-bit errors")
print()

print("=== CRC: mod-2 division, generator 10011 (x^4+x+1) ===")

def crc(data_bits, poly_bits):
    r = len(poly_bits) - 1
    bits = list(data_bits + "0" * r)
    for i in range(len(data_bits)):
        if bits[i] == "1":
            for j in range(len(poly_bits)):
                bits[i + j] = "1" if bits[i + j] != poly_bits[j] else "0"
    return "".join(bits[-r:])

for data, poly in (("1101011111", "10011"), ("1010", "10011"), ("1011001", "1101")):
    rem = crc(data, poly)
    sent = data + rem
    ok = crc(sent, poly)
    flip = sent[:-1] + ("0" if sent[-1] == "1" else "1")
    bad = crc(flip, poly)
    print(f"  data={data:<12} gen={poly:<6} r={len(poly)-1}")
    print(f"    FCS = {rem}   transmitted = {sent}")
    print(f"    verify(no error)  = {ok}  -> all-zero means OK")
    print(f"    verify(1 bit flip)= {bad}  -> non-zero means DETECTED")
print()
print("=== capability comparison ===")
print("  parity  : 1 bit overhead, detects odd number of bit errors, cannot correct")
print("  Hamming : r parity bits, corrects 1-bit, detects 2-bit errors")
print("  CRC     : r bits, detects ALL odd-bit errors, ALL bursts <= r, and most others")
print("            but CRC NEVER corrects -> the frame is simply dropped (then TCP retransmits)")
